paul (Docs): i'm opening a tiny PR to clarify batching vs kv-prefetch on the Optimize Toolkit page. found a stale link and a vague example for short prompts.
ada (Eng): great. include both python + go snippets and explicit numbers (prefetch_window=32). show that runtime skips prefetch for very short prefixes (e.g., <8 tokens).
paul (Docs): draft py snippet:
```python
reqs = [{"prompt": p, "max_tokens":24} for p in prompts]
client.batch_generate(reqs, prefetch_window=32, enable_kv_prefetch=True)
```
ada (Eng): thanks. also add a one-line note about memory tradeoffs and Dedicated tuning.
nina (ML): quant note: "For prefix-sensitive workloads prefer 8-bit/mixed precision; if you try 4-bit, validate with the eval harness as some 4-bit configs affect kv cache behavior." add link to eval.
sam (DevEx): include a debug tip: enable client debug and grep for "prefetch_applied=true" or "prefetch_skipped=short_prefix" so users can verify behavior. add a tiny go snippet for parity.
paul (Docs): go snippet:
```go
reqs := make([]GenerateRequest, len(prompts))
for i,p := range prompts { reqs[i] = GenerateRequest{Prompt: p, MaxTokens:24} }
client.BatchGenerate(ctx, reqs, WithKVPrefetch(32))
```

ria (QA): i'll run a small perf toggle (prefetch on/off) from examples/optkit/perf and paste p50/p95 into the PR; tag me when examples PR is ready.
paul (Docs): checklist in PR desc: fix stale link, add py+go snippets, call out short-prefix threshold (<8), memory tradeoffs, quant recommendation + eval link, debug grep tip, examples perf script. tagging ada/nina/sam/ria for review. :rocket:
